text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today, continuing a strong four-day rally that's recovered most of last week's losses. The move comes as oil prices have stabilized around $90/barrel globally, and heating oil prices have spiked 59% year-over-year, signaling robust demand for refined energy products heading into winter. The stock has climbed nearly $6 in just four days, suggesting investors are repositioning into energy ahead of potential supply tightness.

However, there's a countercurrent: the IEA reported that Russian crude production has rebounded following a Trump diesel deal, pushing global oil markets back into surplus. This broader oversupply picture may be why the stock is still down 7.6% over the full two-week span despite today's bounce—the initial concern about tight supplies appears to be easing, even as winter demand props up refined product prices.
